resources.string: Move any key anywhere. Make it bigger, smaller, or split it for two thumbs.\nSuggestions wait above the keys. Nothing you type changes unless you pick a word.

Android lists keyboards in its settings. Turn on TailorKeys there, then come back.\nAndroid warns that any keyboard can read what you type. TailorKeys can\'t connect to the internet, so your typing stays on this device.
Choose TailorKeys from the list.\nTo switch keyboards later, tap the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen.
Put keys where you want them
Tap the gear above the keys, then Rearrange. Drag a key to move it.\nDrop a key on another key\'s edge to slide it in. Drop it in the middle to stack both into one swipe key.

Swipe a stacked key left or right to change it. Tap abc once for a capital, twice for caps lock.\nSpin a suggestion wheel sideways and tap a word, or hold a spacebar to pick that side\'s word.\nTo move the cursor, hold the empty space between the keys and push. Lift and press again to select text.
Type a few words below. Size, split and tilt are in settings.
